picks.title: Black founders raise highest amount of quarterly funding since 2022, but there's a catch
picks.why_it_matters: Signals a potential thawing in undercapitalized founder segments, presenting both a sourcing opportunity and a reminder that network-driven deal access remains a structural barrier VCs can exploit or help solve.

picks.title: Nvidia's new world model helps robots navigate the world
picks.why_it_matters: Open-source world models from Nvidia lower the barrier for robotics and AV startups, creating a new infrastructure layer that could spawn fundable applications in embodied AI.
